clips.send: Erosion and transport. Water, wind and ice carry sediment away. Rivers are the biggest movers of sediment on land. Tumbling in the water rounds and smooths the grains. Faster water can carry bigger pieces; when water slows down, it drops them.

clips.send: Metamorphic rock. Heat and pressure change rock without melting it. Rock buried deep or squeezed by colliding plates, or baked next to magma, changes form. Minerals recrystallize and often line up in bands (foliation), like in gneiss and schist. Limestone, marble, shale, slate, sandstone, quartzite, granite, gneiss. The rock stays solid the whole time; that is what makes it metamorphic.
clips.text: Metamorphic rock. Heat and pressure change rock without melting it. Rock buried deep or squeezed by colliding plates, or baked next to magma, changes form.. Minerals recrystallize and often line up in bands (foliation), like in gneiss and schist.. Limestone → marble, shale → slate, sandstone → quartzite, granite → gneiss.. The rock stays solid the whole time; that is what makes it metamorphic.

clips.send: Intrusive igneous rock. Magma cools slowly underground. Magma trapped underground cools over thousands to millions of years. Slow cooling lets big crystals grow, so you can see the separate minerals, like in granite. Granite is mostly quartz, feldspar and mica. Minerals are the building blocks of rocks. Georgia’s Stone Mountain is a huge intrusive body that later was uncovered by erosion.

clips.send: Common mix-up: Metamorphic rock does NOT melt. If it melts, it becomes magma, and the rock that forms from it later is igneous.
clips.text: Common mix-up: Metamorphic rock does NOT melt. If it melts, it becomes magma, and the rock that forms from it later is igneous.

clips.send: Magma and melting. Rock melts deep underground. Deep underground it is hot enough (about 700–1,300 degrees Celsius ) for rock to melt into magma. Magma is less dense than the solid rock around it, so it slowly rises. Any rock type (igneous, sedimentary or metamorphic) can melt and start the cycle again.

Magma is less dense than the solid rock around it, so it slowly rises.. Any rock type (igneous, sedimentary or metamorphic) can melt and start the cycle again.

clips.send: Extrusive igneous rock. Lava cools quickly at the surface. Lava erupts and cools in hours to years, so crystals have little time to grow. Fast cooling makes fine-grained rock like basalt, or glassy rock like obsidian. Gas bubbles trapped in cooling lava make pumice, a rock light enough to float on water!

clips.send: Sedimentary rock. Layers are compacted and cemented. The weight of new layers squeezes water out of the sediment below (compaction). Minerals dissolved in the water, such as calcite or silica, glue the grains together (cementation). Sand becomes sandstone, mud becomes shale, pebbles become conglomerate and shells become limestone. Sedimentary rocks are where almost all fossils are found.

clips.send: Weathering. Rock breaks down into sediment. Mountains pushed up by plate movement (uplift) are attacked by ice, water, plants and chemicals. Mechanical weathering breaks rock into pieces; chemical weathering changes its minerals (for example, feldspar turns into clay). The pieces, called sediment, range from boulders to sand, silt and clay.

clips.send: Deposition. Sediment settles in layers. Where a river enters the sea it slows down and drops its sediment, building a delta. Sediment settles in flat layers, with the oldest at the bottom. Shells and the remains of living things can be buried too; later they may become fossils.

clips.send: 容易混淆：变质岩的形成不经过熔化。如果岩石熔化了，就成了岩浆，之后形成的是岩浆岩。

clips.send: 侵蚀与搬运。水、风和冰把沉积物运走。河流是陆地上搬运沉积物最多的“搬运工”。颗粒在水中翻滚碰撞，变得越来越圆、越来越光滑。水流越快，能搬运的颗粒越大；水流变慢，就把它们放下。
clips.text: 侵蚀与搬运. 水、风和冰把沉积物运走. 河流是陆地上搬运沉积物最多的“搬运工”。. 颗粒在水中翻滚碰撞，变得越来越圆、越来越光滑。. 水流越快，能搬运的颗粒越大；水流变慢，就把它们放下。

clips.send: 变质岩。高温高压使岩石变质，但不熔化。埋得很深、被相撞的板块挤压，或紧挨岩浆被“烘烤”的岩石，会改变形态。矿物重新结晶，常排列成条带（片理），如片麻岩和片岩。石灰岩，大理岩，页岩，板岩，砂岩，石英岩，花岗岩，片麻岩。整个过程中岩石一直保持固态，这正是变质岩的特点。
clips.text: 变质岩. 高温高压使岩石变质，但不熔化. 埋得很深、被相撞的板块挤压，或紧挨岩浆被“烘烤”的岩石，会改变形态。. 矿物重新结晶，常排列成条带（片理），如片麻岩和片岩。. 石灰岩 → 大理岩，页岩 → 板岩，砂岩 → 石英岩，花岗岩 → 片麻岩。. 整个过程中岩石一直保持固态，这正是变质岩的特点。

clips.send: 喷出岩（岩浆岩）。熔岩在地表快速冷却。熔岩喷出后在几小时到几年内冷却，晶体来不及长大。快速冷却形成细粒的玄武岩，或者像玻璃一样的黑曜岩。冷却的熔岩里包着气泡就形成浮石，它轻得能浮在水面上！

clips.send: 岩浆与熔化。岩石在地下深处熔化。地下深处温度很高（约 700到1300 摄氏度 ），岩石会熔化成岩浆。岩浆比周围的固态岩石密度小，所以会缓慢上升。任何一种岩石（岩浆岩、沉积岩或变质岩）都可能熔化，重新开始循环。
clips.text: 岩浆与熔化. 岩石在地下深处熔化. 地下深处温度很高（约 700~1300 °C），岩石会熔化成岩浆。. 岩浆比周围的固态岩石密度小，所以会缓慢上升。. 任何一种岩石（岩浆岩、沉积岩或变质岩）都可能熔化，重新开始循环。

clips.send: 容易混淆：变质岩不是熔化形成的，而是在固态下被高温高压改变的。
clips.text: 容易混淆：变质岩不是熔化形成的，而是在固态下被高温高压改变的。

clips.send: 风化作用。岩石破碎成沉积物。板块运动抬升起来的山脉（抬升作用）不断受到冰、水、植物和化学作用的“攻击”。物理（机械）风化把岩石破碎成小块；化学风化改变岩石中的矿物（例如长石变成黏土）。这些碎屑叫沉积物，大小从巨砾到沙、粉砂和黏土。

clips.send: 沉积作用。沉积物一层层沉积下来。河流入海时流速变慢，放下沉积物，形成三角洲。沉积物一层层平铺下来，最老的在最下面。贝壳和生物遗体也可能被一起掩埋，日后可能变成化石。

clips.send: 沉积岩。沉积层被压实和胶结。上面新沉积层的重量把下面沉积物中的水挤出来（压实作用）。水中溶解的矿物（如方解石、二氧化硅）把颗粒粘在一起（胶结作用）。沙变成砂岩，泥变成页岩，砾石变成砾岩，贝壳变成石灰岩。几乎所有的化石都是在沉积岩里发现的。
